observations.title: F60 Web persisted block state, unblock and 409 reread on source B
steps: Web A normal OTP on the new host unified-source-b.localhost:53016 (no cookie copying) returns to H profile: “You have blocked this member. Private contact is disabled.” with Unblock QA Final Host; a fresh reload shows the same persisted state (block A→H active since 01:01Z).
Second tab unblocks: DELETE /v1/blocks/H 200 (unblock, requestId 930101d8-96e9-48a9-9bee-af000b0bb678); status and Unblock control disappear.

The stale first tab clicks Unblock: DELETE 409 VERSION_CONFLICT (requestId d7507240-1dcd-4b77-a6b1-f6662a253946), followed by GET /v1/blocks/H 200; UI shows the real unblocked state (no Unblock control) and “This was updated elsewhere. We’ve refreshed the latest details; please check and try again.”
Not executed: honest copy on a block-state read failure (needs a client-scoped network fault; no such tool). Original F60 failures (B65) retained.

observations.title: J004 native-host/Web-applicant: unblock does not revive consent or private messaging
steps: After both directions are unblocked (latest block revisions inactive, blocks table 0): pair_consents unchanged (epoch1 and epoch3 rows all revoked, no new row), direct messages unchanged (4).
Web A DM shows “Your previous messages are read-only. A new mutual connection is needed to send messages.”, no composer or Send; Web A post-meal reconnect checkbox unchecked, no mutual or Say hello.

native200 (client 3ee69fe, CDHash 8e35fda4…, read-only): H DM shows “History is read-only.” with no Message field or Send; H post-meal shows “QA Final Applicant · Not chosen” and the I’d meet again control, no Undo.

observations.title: Third account B privacy for the native-host/Web-applicant direction
steps: Web B normal OTP on the new host. H and A profiles show only public bios and the mutually published references; no reconnect, block or private-message state.

B opens the H–A direct conversation URL: UI “Your chat opens after confirmation”; B’s own GET messages?mode=HISTORY returns 404 NOT_FOUND (requestId 633e5743-6489-43ef-8f5a-b89bd3a55a7a), no messages. A 200 entry in the tab log came from A’s earlier session in the same tab.
